title: Private Use Allowed while a Registration Stands Past Its Expiry
content:
Where the registration on file for a Keyturn Vehicle Listing stands past its expiry, private use is allowed against the reported stretch, and how much turns on whether a registration has been verified recently.

| Registration on file | Registration verified within 7 calendar days of the handling date | Allowed against the reported stretch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than 7 calendar days past its expiry | yes | 60 miles |
| more than 7 calendar days past its expiry | no | 30 miles |
| any other case | — | 0 miles |

As clauses: a vehicle whose registration on file stands more than 7 calendar days past its expiry and whose registration has been verified within 7 calendar days of the handling date is allowed 60 miles of private use against the reported stretch; one whose registration stands more than 7 calendar days past its expiry with no registration verified within 7 calendar days is allowed 30 miles; and any other vehicle is allowed none on this ground.

*Two clocks of 7 calendar days.* The first counts from the expiry of the registration on file and must be exceeded; the second counts back from the handling date to the most recent registration verification and is met at its boundary. A registration 20 calendar days past expiry, verified exactly 7 calendar days before the handling date, is allowed 60 miles; the same registration last verified 8 calendar days before the handling date is allowed 30 miles.
